column4: Visit note | 2025-10-06 10:30 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Sukumar Nath, 19, male. Mr. Nath attends for review regarding his skin, reporting spots on his back, persistent pimples and blackheads on his face, and marks left behind by previous breakouts. His condition has felt worse since working as a shopkeeper in a hot kitchen in Rangpur. He has Bronchial asthma. He denies fever or joint pains. On examination: about 28 inflamed spots on the face, with deep painful lumps along the jawline only, BP 114/80 mmHg, pulse 70 bpm, weight 64 kg. Chest is clear. Assessment: Acne vulgaris. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to wash his face twice daily with a gentle cleanser and avoid squeezing spots. Follow-up in 2 months.
